etymologies.etymologyHTML: From pregnant +‎ -cy.

definitions.definition: (countable) The condition of being pregnant; an instance of this.

quote.text: News that the duchess is in the "very early stages" of pregnancy with the third-in-line to the throne was officially released after she was taken to the King Edward VII hospital in central London, suffering from hyperemesis gravidarun, very acute morning sickness.

quote.citation: 2015 October 23, “Periconception Maternal Folate Status and Human Embryonic Cerebellum Growth Trajectories: The Rotterdam Predict Study”, in PLOS ONE‎[2], →DOI:
quote.text: Viable non-malformed singleton pregnancies were selected for cerebellar measurements; transcerebellar diameter, (TCD), left and right cerebellar diameters (LCD, RCD).

definitions.definition: The period of time this condition prevails.
(uncountable) The progression of stages from conception to birth.
